shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for white cards on the cool gray ground.

shadows.name: primary-button
shadows.purpose: Small depth cue for the primary action.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a management screen.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 37px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: #2563eb; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 3px 7px #2563eb25; font: 600 11px Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s, transform .16s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet bordered action for copy and secondary tasks.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 37px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #dfe5ed; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: #46546a; font: 600 11px Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s, transform .16s; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #f6f8fb; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact white field with a clear blue focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #48566b; font: 600 10px Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { height: 37px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #dfe5ed; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: #29364a; font: 400 11px Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #6f9cf3; outline: 3px solid #3b82f616; }

components.name: Management Card
components.description: A white bounded surface for token details and setup controls.
components.html:
Access token

Manage permissions for this token.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 19px 20px; border: 1px solid #e7ebf0; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #182338; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px #24324a06; font: 400 12px/1.65 Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { color: #263348; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #778397; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The active destination in the compact mailbox-aware rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 10px 11px; border-radius: 8px; background: #edf4ff; color: #2461d9; font: 600 12px Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #e5efff; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Permission Switch
components.description: An individually labeled, compact tool permission control.
components.css: .ds-permission { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; min-height: 34px; padding-right: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f2f5; color: #526074; font: 400 10px Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-permission input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-permission i { width: 29px; height: 17px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 20px; background: #cbd2dc; transition: background .15s; } .ds-permission i::after { content: ''; display: block; width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px #24324a25; transition: transform .15s; } .ds-permission input:checked + i { background: #3979ee; } .ds-permission input:checked + i::after { transform: translateX(12px); } .ds-permission input:focus-visible + i { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: A calm control surface for personal mailbox access.
narrative.overview: The management UI keeps mailbox identity and token controls easy to scan. A compact navigation rail, cool light ground, white bounded surfaces, restrained blue actions, and clear status labels make the service feel dependable without turning it into a generic operations dashboard. Locally hosted Lato supplies a consistent voice. The product title and optional raster logo are deployment-configurable; when no logo is set, the existing blue M mark remains.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Use color to indicate action or state; rely on surface contrast and fine borders for ordinary structure.

rules.name: The Mailbox Context Rule
rules.body: Keep the connected mailbox identity visible alongside its personal access-token controls.

dos: Do keep mailbox identity, token state, and tool permissions in the same management flow.
Do show the full user token only at creation and provide a copy action.
Do keep SMTP permission conditional on SMTP being configured.
Do use inline SVGs for interface icons instead of text glyphs.
donts: Don't add unrelated dashboard, billing, team, or account-navigation patterns.
Don't use decorative display type or heavy shadows.
